name: ds3231

expect.contains:
RTC lost power, let's set the time!
2026/10/18 (Sunday) 12:0:0
 since midnight 1/1/1970 = 1792324800s = 20744d
 now + 7d + 12h + 30m + 6s: 2026/10/26 0:30:6
Temperature: 0.00 C

2026/10/18 (Sunday) 12:0:3
 since midnight 1/1/1970 = 1792324803s = 20744d
 now + 7d + 12h + 30m + 6s: 2026/10/26 0:30:9
Temperature: 24.25 C

description: RTClib's ds3231 example, unmodified: the part powers up with OSF set, so lostPower() is true and the sketch sets the clock to its build time (2026-10-18 12:00:00: run.py fixes SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, the reproducible-builds convention GCC honours for __DATE__ and __TIME__) and clears OSF. The clock then counts: 12:0:0, and 12:0:3 three seconds later, with the date arithmetic the library does on it. The first temperature reads 0.00 C: the sketch asks 30 ms after power-up, before the power-up conversion (125 ms) has filled the register, whose power-on value is 00h; the next reads the air's 24.3 C in 0.25 C steps, 24.25.
